### What Worked
Your NY AM killzone trades carried the week — patient sweep-then-BOS entries with defined risk. Win rate held above your baseline when you waited for confirmation.

### What Didn't
The two rule-break trades (early entries before the FVG filled) account for most of the week's edge leak. Both were outside your A+ setups.

### Killzone Review
NY AM was your strongest session; Asia was flat. Consider concentrating size in NY AM where your read is sharpest.

### Rule Adherence
You followed your plan on the majority of trades. The misses clustered around entry timing, not direction — a fixable, mechanical issue.

### Focus for Next Week
Anchor every entry to the completed FVG fill. If it hasn't filled, it isn't your setup. One process tweak, measurable next week.
